description: Scrape Traveloka accommodation listings by city, paginated listing pages, and Traveloka Xperience travel-guide articles.

citySlug.description: Traveloka accommodation listing page to scrape (mode=browseByCity). All pages are paginated automatically up to `maxPages`.
citySlug.title: City / area (mode=browseByCity)

containsKeyword.description: Only emit hotels whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).
containsKeyword.title: Contains keyword

exploreCategory.description: Traveloka Explore category to page through (mode=browseExplore).
exploreCategory.title: Article category (mode=browseExplore)

includeArticleDetails.description: Also open each article page to add the full body text, section headings and images, plus description, table of contents and related articles. Adds one request per article.
includeArticleDetails.title: Fetch article details

includeArticles.description: In search mode, also emit every article from the fetched Explore pages, not only keyword matches.
includeArticles.title: Include all explored articles

includeHotelDetails.description: Also fetch each hotel's cookieless detail data to add address, coordinates, facilities, check-in/out, policies and up to 20 reviews. Adds one request per hotel.
includeHotelDetails.title: Fetch hotel details

locale.description: Traveloka store locale. The locale also sets the price currency shown on listing pages (e.g. `en-sg` → SGD).
locale.title: Locale / currency

maxPages.description: Maximum listing/category pages to fetch per source. `0` means all pages until `maxItems` or the source is exhausted.
maxPages.title: Max listing pages

maxPrice.description: Only hotels whose listed starting price is at most this amount, in the locale's currency (see `locale`).
maxPrice.title: Max price

minPrice.description: Only hotels whose listed starting price is at least this amount, in the locale's currency (see `locale`).
minPrice.title: Min price

minRating.description: Only hotels with a guest score of at least this (Traveloka uses a 0–10 scale).
minRating.title: Min user rating

minReviewCount.description: Only hotels with at least this many guest reviews.
minReviewCount.title: Min review count

minStarRating.description: Only hotels with at least this many stars.
minStarRating.title: Min star rating

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy. Only used after a direct request is blocked (403/429). Leave empty for the zero-cost default.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQuery.description: City, area, or travel keyword (mode=search), e.g. `yogyakarta`, `bali`, `hotel bali`, `train`. City/area queries return accommodation listings; other keywords match Traveloka Xperience article titles and summaries.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search)

sortBy.description: Applied to the fetched hotel records before the output cap. `relevance` keeps Traveloka's own popularity order.
sortBy.title: Sort results

startUrls.description: Traveloka URLs to scrape (mode=byUrl): accommodation listing pages, explore category pages, or explore article pages. Listing pages are paginated automatically.

url.description: A full Traveloka accommodation, explore category or article URL.
url.title: Page URL

startUrls.title: Page URLs (mode=byUrl)

title: Traveloka Hotel & Explore Scraper Input
